title: Aim and movement are being trained as separate problems
summary: The player treats mouse control and movement as unrelated, so transfer suffers whenever the in-game task requires aiming while repositioning.
telltales: Aim quality falls apart as soon as the player has to move during the task
The routine contains almost no aim-while-moving or anti-movement work
contraindications: Do not pretend movement drills fully replace learning actual player dodge patterns in game
avoid: Treating movement as someone else's problem while trying to improve FPS aim
